title: BUG: `DataFrame.mean(axis=1)` fails but `Series.mean` works incase of pandas Nullable integer dtype

labels.name: Needs Tests
labels.description: Unit test(s) needed to prevent regressions

labels.name: NA - MaskedArrays
labels.description: Related to pd.NA and nullable extension arrays

body:
- [x] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.

- [x] I have confirmed this bug exists on the latest version of pandas.

- [ ] (optional) I have confirmed this bug exists on the master branch of pandas.

---

**Note**: Please read [this guide](https://matthewrocklin.com/blog/work/2018/02/28/minimal-bug-reports) detailing how to provide the necessary information for us to reproduce your bug.

a     2.5
b    <NA>

b    <NA>

#### Problem description

When there is a row-wise mean calculation of a nullable interger dtype the operation fails. But the same operation works correctly on a series by doing an iloc on the row.
